mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM sys_user_post p
INNER JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id AND u.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_project project ON p.project_id = project.id
INNER JOIN sys_role r ON p.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_org org ON p.org_id = org.id
INNER JOIN sys_post_module_access pma ON p.id = pma.post_id
INNER JOIN sys_business_module bm ON pma.module_id = bm.id
INNER JOIN sys_module_permission mp ON bm.id = mp.module_id
INNER JOIN sys_permission perm ON mp.permission_id = perm.id
INNER JOIN sys_post_permission_grant pg ON pg.post_id = p.id AND pg.permission_id = perm.id
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND bm.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND perm.permission_code = #{permissionCode}
AND p.status = 1 AND project.status = 1 AND org.status = 1 AND bm.status = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_project_org po WHERE po.project_id = p.project_id AND po.org_id = p.org_id )
AND ( p.post_type = 'BASIC'
OR ( p.post_type = 'MANAGEMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_management_authorization ma WHERE ma.user_id = p.user_id AND ma.status = 1 ) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_post_permission_delegation ( source_post_id, target_post_id, permission_id, status ) VALUES ( #{sourcePostId}, #{targetPostId}, #{permissionId}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, scope_type, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_post_data_scope WHERE post_id = #{postId}

SELECT o.id FROM sys_post_scope_org pso
INNER JOIN sys_post_data_scope ds ON pso.post_scope_id = ds.id
INNER JOIN sys_org o ON pso.org_id = o.id
WHERE ds.post_id = #{postId} AND ds.scope_type = 'CUSTOM' AND o.status = 1
SELECT p.org_id FROM sys_user_post p INNER JOIN sys_org o ON p.org_id = o.id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 1 AND o.status = 1

SELECT po.org_id FROM sys_project_org po
INNER JOIN sys_project p ON po.project_id = p.id
INNER JOIN sys_org o ON po.org_id = o.id
WHERE po.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status = 1 AND o.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM sys_user_post p
INNER JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id AND u.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_project project ON p.project_id = project.id AND project.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_org org ON p.org_id = org.id AND org.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_role r ON p.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_post_module_access pma ON p.id = pma.post_id
INNER JOIN sys_business_module bm ON pma.module_id = bm.id AND bm.status = 1
INNER JOIN sys_module_permission mp ON mp.module_id = bm.id
INNER JOIN sys_permission perm ON mp.permission_id = perm.id
INNER JOIN sys_post_permission_grant pg ON pg.post_id = p.id AND pg.permission_id = perm.id
INNER JOIN sys_post_delegable_permission dp ON dp.post_id = p.id AND dp.permission_id = perm.id
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND bm.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND perm.permission_code = #{permissionCode}
AND p.status = 1 AND p.post_type = 'MANAGEMENT'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_management_authorization ma WHERE ma.user_id = u.id AND ma.status = 1 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_project_org po WHERE po.project_id = p.project_id AND po.org_id = p.org_id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_post_permission_grant configure_grant
INNER JOIN sys_module_permission configure_mp ON configure_grant.permission_id = configure_mp.permission_id
INNER JOIN sys_permission configure_perm ON configure_grant.permission_id = configure_perm.id
WHERE configure_grant.post_id = p.id AND configure_mp.module_id = bm.id AND configure_perm.permission_code = CASE bm.module_code WHEN 'CONSTRUCTION' THEN 'construction:permission:configure'
WHEN 'SUPERVISION' THEN 'supervision:permission:configure'
ELSE '__UNSUPPORTED_MODULE__' END )

SELECT p.id FROM sys_user_post p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id AND u.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_project pr ON p.project_id = pr.id AND pr.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_org o ON p.org_id = o.id AND o.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON p.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 WHERE p.id = #{targetPostId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_project_org po WHERE po.project_id = p.project_id AND po.org_id = p.org_id )

SELECT p.id FROM sys_user_post p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id AND u.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_project pr ON p.project_id = pr.id AND pr.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON p.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_org o ON p.org_id = o.id AND o.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_post_module_access pma ON pma.post_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_business_module bm ON pma.module_id = bm.id AND bm.status = 1 WHERE p.id = #{targetPostId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status = 1 AND bm.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_project_org po WHERE po.project_id = p.project_id AND po.org_id = p.org_id )

SELECT p.id FROM sys_module_permission mp INNER JOIN sys_business_module bm ON mp.module_id = bm.id AND bm.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON mp.permission_id = p.id WHERE bm.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND p.permission_code = #{permissionCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id FROM sys_user_post p
INNER JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id
INNER JOIN sys_project pr ON p.project_id = pr.id
INNER JOIN sys_org o ON p.org_id = o.id
INNER JOIN sys_role r ON p.role_id = r.id
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND pr.status = 1 AND o.status = 1 AND r.status = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_project_org po WHERE po.project_id = p.project_id AND po.org_id = p.org_id )
AND ( p.post_type = 'BASIC'
OR ( p.post_type = 'MANAGEMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_management_authorization ma WHERE ma.user_id = p.user_id AND ma.status = 1 ) ) )
